# ABM Program Design

`abm-program-design` · v1.0.0 · Design · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/abm-program-design/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Can our team actually run this account list, and would it hit the pipeline target if they did?

**Inputs:** The pipeline target and period, average contract value, how many hours a week the team can genuinely give ABM, and per tier the account count, touches per month, minutes per touch and the engagement, opportunity and win rates

**Output:** A viability verdict, hours needed against hours available, expected pipeline against target, the binding constraint named, the list the team could actually run, and hours per opportunity by tier

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill abm-program-design`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/abm-program-design/resources/abm-design.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/abm-program-design/resources/abm-design.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Capacity is only as honest as the hours a week entered. Headcount or "50 per cent on ABM" inflates it; the skill says to halve the number if those people own a lot else.
- Engagement, opportunity and win rates are inputs. Benchmark rates make coverage a forecast of someone else's business; label them as placeholders and re-run monthly with actuals.
- It assumes every listed account gets its planned touches. An account nobody contacts still counts toward coverage, so a list the team cannot touch overstates expected pipeline.
- It does not check that the accounts fit the ICP. Run it only on a fit-scored list, or it sizes the wrong work.

**Review before acting:** The founder or sales lead confirms the ABM hours against what those people already own, and whether the rates are your history or placeholders, before the list size or team is set.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/abm-program-design](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/abm-program-design)
